scripts.format: pnpm --dir apps/frontend exec prettier --write . ../../README.md ../../docs ../../infra ../api/README.md ../../package.json ../../pnpm-workspace.yaml ../../vercel.json ../../.github && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/api/Cargo.toml
scripts.format:check: pnpm --dir apps/frontend exec prettier --check . ../../README.md ../../docs ../../infra ../api/README.md ../../package.json ../../pnpm-workspace.yaml ../../vercel.json ../../.github && cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/api/Cargo.toml -- --check
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir apps/frontend lint && cargo clippy --manifest-path apps/api/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm --dir apps/frontend test && cargo test --manifest-path apps/api/Cargo.toml
scripts.build: pnpm --dir apps/frontend build && cargo build --manifest-path apps/api/Cargo.toml --locked
